test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Raigad Fort?

(1) It is part of the 12 forts nominated for UNESCO World Heritage under the title “Maratha Military Landscapes of India” for 2024-25.

(2) It was the capital of the most illustrious Maratha sovereign, nurtured by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

(3) Raigad, surrounded by valleys shaped by the Kal and Gandhari rivers, stands as an isolated massif without connections to neighbouring hills.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1, 2 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raigad Fort** is one of the 12 forts nominated under the title **"Maratha Military Landscapes of India"** for **UNESCO World Heritage** status for the year **2024-25**. This reflects its historical and architectural significance.
 
• It was the **capital** of the Maratha Empire and the seat of **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**, the most illustrious Maratha sovereign. Shivaji Maharaj was formally coronated as the **Chhatrapati** at Raigad in **1674**.
 
• The fort is geographically unique, being surrounded by **valleys** shaped by the **Kal and Gandhari rivers**. It is an isolated massif without any direct connection to neighboring hills, making it a natural fortress and strategically advantageous.
 
• Raigad Fort is located in the **Sahyadri mountain range** in the state of **Maharashtra**, India.
 
• The fort is also known for its remarkable features, including the **Maha Darwaja** (main gate), the **Samadhi of Shivaji Maharaj**, and the **Jagadishwar Temple**.
 
• Its location and structure demonstrate the **military and architectural acumen** of the Marathas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Nomination**__

 __
 
• The nomination of 12 forts, including Raigad, under the title **"Maratha Military Landscapes of India"**, aims to recognize the **historical and cultural importance** of Maratha architecture and military strategies.
 
• Other forts in this nomination include **Shivneri, Rajgad, Torna, and Sindhudurg**, highlighting the Marathas' strategic planning and engineering skills.
 
 
 
• **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**__
 __
 
• Shivaji Maharaj was the founder of the **Maratha Empire**, which played a critical role in resisting Mughal dominance in India.
 
• He was known for his **administrative reforms**, the establishment of a strong navy, and strategic fortifications like Raigad.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Importance of Raigad Fort**__
 
 
• Its location on an **isolated hill**, surrounded by deep valleys, made it a natural fortress.
 
• The fort's design ensured **defense and surveillance**, with steep pathways and narrow entrances that provided added security.
